persona.title: PhD Candidate — Aerospace Engineering
persona.bio: I am a 28-year-old aerospace engineer completing my PhD at Politecnico di Torino. My research focuses on advanced space propulsion systems and autonomous GNC architectures for next-generation spacecraft. I combine a strong analytical background with hands-on experience in simulation, embedded systems, and experimental testing. I thrive in interdisciplinary teams and I am equally comfortable writing flight software prototypes and presenting results at international conferences. Driven by curiosity and rigour, I am looking for opportunities in both industry R&D and academic research.
